scope: 固定 SHA 增量和预先锁定的中央构建/运行边界；仅静态恶意行为审查。

inherited_boundary.boundary: Existing central keeper workflow substitutes cliproxyapiplus/Dockerfile.keeper; node:22-alpine npm ci and npm run build; golang:1.26-alpine go mod download and CGO build cmd/server/main.go with cmd/internal/web static inputs; alpine:3.24 runtime with docker-entrypoint.sh, embedded frontend and /data. Review all changed files including tests/docs; only changed dependency provenance/install behavior and necessary sensitive implementations. Reuse identical baseline inputs.
exclusions: Do not recursively review unchanged approved dependencies or baseline source.

Upstream CI/dev action/toolchain implementations not executed by central workflow remain outside recursive dependency verification; changed upstream workflow files themselves still require full review.

boundary.actual_central_build_note: Current hashed Dockerfile uses CGO_ENABLED=1 with build-base. Inherited textual CGO description is stale; actual unchanged approved central file is authoritative.

module_findings.plugin_identity_ingestion: 上游 is_native_key/access_provider 元数据仅为统计身份编码；事务提交后通知内存合并队列，并在本地 SQLite 分批登记，不扫描历史、不执行插件、不新增远端目的地。
module_findings.storage_migration: 仅定向增列；注册采用参数化查询与冲突不覆盖，既有原生 key 同步限定 native；无批量破坏、隐蔽删除或持久化执行。
module_findings.authentication_and_display: 插件身份在 API key 登录和会话恢复入口被拒绝；管理设置路由仍经 adminMiddleware，插件原始 principal 不返回，展示稳定标签和来源。
module_findings.frontend: 单卡显隐、用户触发复制、别名编辑及布局/翻译调整，只沿既有 API；无新脚本加载、外传接收方或动态执行。
module_findings.docs_workflows_images_tests: 完整阅读文档迁移、上游二进制打包 workflow 仅增加 docs 复制、全部测试和配置；12 PNG 两端仅 IHDR/IDAT/IEND，CRC、zlib 流、像素长度和结束位置均验证，且截图不进入中央 COPY 边界。

limits: 未重新认证未变的已批准基线依赖、开发/CI/action/toolchain 实现及第三方插件；不无限递归。
静态增量结论不保证无漏洞/无 Bug，不审查正确性、质量或性能。
审查中未 clone、安装、构建、执行上游代码/产物，也未运行测试或扫描。
批准后中央 CI 构建发布独立于源审查；来源链不是签名 attestation；不部署或重启。
